name: Megiddo
overview: Megiddo, also known as Megiddon and likely the site referred to as Armageddon, is a significant city located in the territory of Issachar on the southern edge of the plain of Esdraelon. Scripture highlights its strategic importance, noting its conquest by Joshua and its inclusion among the towns overseen by Solomon's commissary Baana, who managed Megiddo along with other key locations. Solomon also fortified Megiddo, building its walls as part of his extensive construction projects. The city is marked by pivotal historical events, including the death of King Ahaziah who fled there, and the slaying of King Josiah by Pharaoh Nechoh, underscoring its role in the unfolding of God's sovereign plan.
